items.title: Kenny Burrell — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Maybe Ozzy did do some A&R for him, I'm not sure.

ctx.x: Yeah. You get a call and it was usually Bob Weinstock that would call the guys. He was the president, also his own A&R man I guess. Maybe Ozzy did do some A&R for him, I'm not sure. The point was, you'd get the call and you were expected to bring in one or two songs, usually two. Everybody brings in a song or two, you get there and you run it down maybe once or twice and you'd record it. So those are two of the songs I brought in. I brought in "All Day Long" which is a blues and "All Night Long" might be a blues…
